# laravelcloud_environments (Resource)

Manages an environment of an application in Laravel Cloud.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelcloud_environments" "example" {
  application = "application-id"
  name        = "production"
  branch      = "main"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application` (String) The application this resource belongs to.
- `branch` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) The identifier of a dedicated cluster to deploy to. Only fill it if your organization has a dedicated cluster and you want to use it for this environment.
- `environment` (String) The environment identifier

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelcloud_environments.example application-id/the-id
```
